title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Executar rateios de custos industriais, como energia elétrica, gás natural e outros custos indiretos, conforme critérios definidos pela área de controladoria.

Apurar e acompanhar custos relacionados à qualidade e bonificação de nutrientes, consolidando informações para análise gerencial.
Analisar dados operacionais e financeiros das áreas produtivas, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria de processos e programas de redução de custos.
Interagir com áreas operacionais e de melhoria contínua, apoiando análises e diagnósticos relacionados ao desempenho industrial.
Elaborar e divulgar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho que suportem a tomada de decisão da gestão operacional.
Apoiar o Coordenador de Controle Industrial nas demandas da área de controladoria industrial, realizando análises de dados, auditorias internas e controles diversos.

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical recruiter (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Reboot Monkey
Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
About the Role
Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.
As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do
Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region
Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords
Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score
Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history
Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria
Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training
Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team
Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region
Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them
Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings
Requirements
3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)
Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills
Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring
Fluent written and spoken English
Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision
Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Title: AI Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."
Key Responsibilities
Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows.
Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations.
Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms.
Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar.
Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services
Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred).
Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence.
Hands-on experience with:
LLM Agents
RAG pipelines
Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index
Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
Knowledge of AI governance and security, including:
OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Prompt injection risks
Model supply chain security
Responsible AI controls
Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Platform engineer / devops engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement.
What You'll Do
Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)
Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths"
Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash) Must-Have Requirements
6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles
Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)
Deep Kubernetes expertise:
Operating and maintaining clusters
Experience building Kubernetes environments
Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Strong Linux fundamentals
Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing) Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Git Lab CI
Exposure to Open Telemetry
API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations What We're NOT Looking For
No Kubernetes experience
Bash-only engineers (no Python)
Pure consulting/advisory profiles
Pure security-focused candidates
Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds
ML/Data Science profiles Team Structure
1 Principal Engineer
1 Senior Engineer
1 Engineer (India)
You = 4th key team member

title: Data engineer iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer iii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Posição temporária!
Visão Geral da Posição
A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.
O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.
O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.
O que você fará
Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.
Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.
Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.
Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.
Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.
Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.
Qualificações Mínimas
• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.
• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.
• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).
• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark).
• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.
• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.
• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).
• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.
• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.
• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
• Inglês fluente.
Qualificações Desejáveis
• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.
• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.
• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).
• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.
• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).
• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Forensic manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forensic manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.
Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.
Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.
In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.
To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.
While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

description:

A Mobi7 é uma empresa que utiliza a tecnologia para criar soluções que otimizam a mobilidade, auxiliam na gestão e valorizam a segurança no trânsito. Hoje, nós fazemos parte das empresas da Localiza e temos uma plataforma de gestão de frotas corporativas, criada para monitorar e otimizar o uso de veículos leves ou pesados. E esse é só o começo
O QUE BUSCAMOS:
Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Data Ops para liderar a padronização e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.
O foco principal será desenvolver módulos Terraform reutilizáveis , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.
É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre engenharia de dados , cloud e automação .
Responsabilidades e atribuições Criar e evoluir módulos Terraform para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.); Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines e processos ETL/ELT , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade; Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de Data Ops , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento; Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;
Implementar mecanismos de governança , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.
Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência sólida com Terraform e infraestrutura como código; Vivência prática em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados; Forte conhecimento em pipelines , ETL/ELT e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse); Proficiência em Python e SQL; Experiência com CI/CD aplicado a dados e automação; Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.
Diferenciais
Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;
Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;
Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);
Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.

Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;
Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;
Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.
BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O
Participação em Lucros e Resultados;
Carro Corporativo;
Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;
Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);

Wellhub;
Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;

title: Senior web developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior web developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role
We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.
This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.
If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,
brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.
Key Responsibilities
Website Development
Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).
Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.
API Integrations & Automation Hooks
Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).
Quality, Performance & SEO
Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).
Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.
Collaboration
Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.
Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.
Required Skills
Technical
3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.
Modern Web Skills
Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).
Bonus Experience
(Not required, but highly valuable)
Webflow development experience.
Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).
Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).
Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.
Soft Skills
Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.
What Success Looks Like
In the first 60–90 days, you will:
Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

Recentemente, a Bahiana ganhou, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, o prêmio Great Place To Work (GPTW) , premiação global atribuída às empresas que, de acordo com os seus funcionários, são os melhores lugares para trabalhar. Permanecemos no 1º lugar no ranking das melhores empresas para trabalhar na Bahia. Trabalhar na Bahiana é ter o que chamamos de "Bahianidade na veia" . É compartilhar dos nossos valores de Servir, Empreender, Comunicar, Aprender e ensinar . É por isso que queremos agregar talentos que valorizem a nossa tradição , mas que, como a instituição, mirem no futuro, na inovação e no trabalho  para a construção de um mundo no qual a saúde seja valorizada como um direito básico e universal. /n

Que tal fazer parte do maior e mais tradicional grupo de intermediação imobiliária do país? Especialistas no mercado imobiliário. Com uma equipe de mais de 10.000 corretores associados, a Lopes não é apenas um intermédio na negociação, mas um parceiro para encontrar a melhor oportunidade para você.

Somamos a expertise da empresa líder em negócios imobiliários com tecnologia, para simplificar processos, entregar soluções personalizadas, empoderar o cliente em sua jornada e garantir a melhor experiência.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior backend engineer (golang) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

description:

Buscamos um Coordenador de Administração Contratual com a missão de liderar e gerenciar estrategicamente todos os aspectos contratuais dos projetos da empresa, desde a fase de prospecção até o encerramento. Seu principal objetivo é assegurar a proteção financeira e jurídica da organização, otimizando o desempenho contratual, mitigando riscos e maximizando os resultados através de uma gestão proativa e eficiente de contratos, pleitos e aditivos.
Responsabilidades
● Liderar, desenvolver e gerenciar a equipe de administração contratual, promovendo a capacitação e o alinhamento com as melhores práticas de mercado.
● Desenvolver e implementar estratégias eficazes para a gestão de pleitos (claims) e anti-claims, visando a defesa dos interesses da empresa e a recuperação de custos adicionais.
● Governança Contratual, estabelecer padrões de controle para aditivos, medições e registros diários de obra (RDO)em todos os projetos.
● Assegurar a governança contratual, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas internas da empresa, a legislação vigente (incluindo a Lei nº 14.133/2021 para contratos públicos, quando aplicável) e as cláusulas contratuais.
● Conduzir negociações complexas com clientes, subcontratados, fornecedores e demais partes interessadas, buscando soluções que atendam aos objetivos da empresa.
● Identificar, avaliar e mitigar proativamente os riscos contratuais, desenvolvendo planos de contingência e estratégias de prevenção.
● Supervisionar a elaboração, análise e gestão de aditivos contratuais, garantindo a correta formalização de alterações de escopo, prazos e valores.
● Monitorar e controlar o desempenho financeiro dos contratos, incluindo medições, faturamento e fluxo de caixa, em colaboração com as áreas financeira e de planejamento.
● Elaborar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais periódicos à alta direção, com análises críticas sobre o desempenho contratual, riscos e oportunidades.
● Atuar como ponto focal para questões contratuais, fornecendo suporte e orientação às equipes de projeto e demais departamentos.
● Gestão de correspondência oficial, responsável pela redação, revisão e emissão de todas as cartas, notificações e comunicações formais destinadas ao cliente, garantindo o rigor técnico-jurídico e a preservação de diretos.
Requisitos obrigatórios para a posição:
● Graduação Completa: em Engenharia Civil, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. ● Experiência: Sólida em administração contratual em projetos de grande porte na construção civil, com comprovada experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes, conhecimento em elaboração de minutas e interpretação de cláusulas jurídicas e comerciais. ● Domínio das legislações brasileira (CLT, Lei de Licitações, Lei de Contratos Administrativos). ● Habilidade em negociação e gestão de riscos contratuais.
● Conhecimento prático de ferramentas de gestão de contratos (ERP).

title: Junior business analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior business analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You’ll work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.  
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You’ll also have the opportunity to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. Some examples of the specific work may include interviewing clients, leading client teams, building financial models, and working with Mc Kinsey subject experts to develop perspectives and insights for the client. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site. 
When you join Mc Kinsey, you are joining a firm that will invest in your professional development. You will participate in an introductory training program, as well as a range of social activities to get to know your office and the firm. 
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will receive training and coaching on how to better:

Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them
Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods
Work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act
Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations
Communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner
Develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values Mc Kinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include: 

Engagement colleagues and leadership who will provide feedback regularly to help you improve your daily performance
A professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams
A senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals At the end of your Junior Business Analyst program, you may receive an offer to become a Business Analyst.
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office to work in teams and directly with our clients. This 6 to 24-month program was created to develop talents into real leaders through research, training, mentoring, and coaching sessions. 
Your team colleagues will make you feel welcome and help you be at your best during client engagements. The Professional Development team will complement your experience by tailoring a learning and training program for you, considering your strengths and development needs. 
In this role you will have the opportunity to work on teams and help the best organizations in the world – across the private, public, and social sectors – solve some of their most difficult problems, while you discover coaches, mentors, sponsors and friends in your learning program.

Undergraduate degree in any course, except business administration, economics and engineering
Graduation between Dec 2022 and Jul 2026
Ability to communicate ideas most effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and Portuguese
Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
Capability to drive an independent workstream in the context of a broader team project
Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
Comfort with ambiguous, ever-changing situations

Domínio do idioma: Inglês em nível avançado/fluente, com total capacidade e segurança para ministrar aulas do nível básico ao avançado;
Desenvoltura digital: Facilidade com o uso de tecnologias e naturalidade para criar e gravar conteúdos em texto, áudio e vídeo;

Em 2023, expandimos para o Inglês com um curso especializado em aprendizagem acelerada. Administramos o Clube de Alemão, a Punkify, o Vale-inglês, a SWAI e a S& W Editora, com foco em harmonia, honestidade, agilidade, inovação, resiliência, confiabilidade e inteligência. Nossa missão é habilitar 100 mil brasileiros na fluência funcional do inglês até 2030.

title: Finance manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Finance Manager
Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)
Job Type: Full-Time
Strong financial operations don't just track performance, they drive it. We're looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.
About Uproot Clean
Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.
We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That's where you come in.
The Role
This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.
You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.
This is not a purely back-office role, you'll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.
This Role Is For You If:
You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
You are detail-oriented and highly organized
You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment This Role Is NOT For You If:
You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment What You'll Do
Accounting & Financial Operations
Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
Prepare financial statements and reports
Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records Month-End Close & Process Improvement
Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
Build scalable processes and documentation Team Oversight
Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work Cost & Inventory Accounting
Manage and apply landed costs across products
Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility Reporting & Analysis
Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking Requirements
Must have:
1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
Strong understanding of accounting principles
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and organization Work Requirements
Schedule: Flexble
Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)
Benefits & Compensation
Fully remote
Paid time off
Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy Ready to Apply?
If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Vexos platform manager (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vexos platform manager (remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager
Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil
The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.
We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
About The Render Pros / VEXOS
We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3 D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The Role
The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.
You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What You'll Be Responsible For
• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM
• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials
• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person
• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date
• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track
• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed
• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What We're Looking For
Experience
• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role
• Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus
• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement
Skills
• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily
• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly
• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users
• Highly organized with strong attention to detail
• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure
• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift
Mindset
• You follow through. Every time.
• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated
• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients
• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tools You'll Work With
VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What We Offer
• Competitive salary in USD
• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico
• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder
• A stable, long-term role in a growing company
• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
How to Apply
Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:
1. Who you are and what you've managed
2. Why this role interests you
3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation
Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.
Apply via DM or email:
#hiring #remotejobs #vexos #therenderpos #proptech #projectmanager #clientsuccess #remotework #Brazil #Mexico #latinamerica

title: Analista data viz sr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista data viz sr. em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável.
O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas.
Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão.
Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.
Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes. Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência. Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade. Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização. Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica). Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário. Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica. Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio. Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados. Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.
Requisitos e qualificações
Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics. Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX). Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker. Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico. Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados. Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold). Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI). Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse. Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações. Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards. Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
Requisitos desejáveis
Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.
Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.
Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).
Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.
Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
Experiência com testes e validação de dados.
Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
100% remoto;
Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;
Seguro de Vida;
Plano de Saúde (Porto Seguro);
Plano Odontológico (Porto Seguro);
PLR de acordo com a política da empresa;
Voucher Smash Card no dia do aniversário;
Parceria com escola de inglês;
Programa de indicação #amigosv8.tech;
Total Pass;
Guapeco (benefício pet);
Alura (plataforma de cursos online);
Certificações de parceiros;
Convênio SESC.

title: Devops | home office
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops | home office em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um profissional que será responsável por implementar, configurar e manter servidores, softwares e sistemas. Implementando rotinas automatizadas, otimizando entregas e trazendo segurança, estabilidade e confiabilidade nos ambientes.
Requisitos:
- Desejável superior em análise de sistemas, ciência da computação ou cursos correlatos;
- Conhecimento em redes de computadores (TCP/IP, VPN, Firewall);
- Sistemas Linux/Unix;
- Docker;
- Kubernetes;
- Ia C (Ansible / Terraform);
- Conhecimento em Cloud (Azure / AWS);
- Pipeline CI/CD;
- Observabilidade (Prometheus / Zabbix).
Competências Comportamentais:
- Comprometimento;
- Detalhista;
- Busca por conhecimento constante;
- Prontidão decisória;
- Ética;
- Boa comunicação;
- Visão crítica.
Dentre as atividades a serem desempenhadas:
- Desenvolver scripts e ferramentas para automatizar a configuração, provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura de TI;
- Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar o processo de construção, teste e implantação de código, permitindo entregas de software rápidas e confiáveis;
- Manter e gerenciar configurações de sistemas e aplicativos de maneira consistente em todos os ambientes, utilizando técnicas como versionamento de configuração e infraestrutura como código;
- Padronizar manifests/Helm charts e políticas de configuração para serviços e ambientes;
- Operar Kubernetes/orquestradores com boas práticas de confiabilidade;
- Facilitar a comunicação e a colaboração entre equipes de desenvolvimento, operações e outras partes interessadas, promovendo uma cultura de colaboração e responsabilidade compartilhada;
- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de infraestrutura e aplicativos, garantindo a rápida resolução de incidentes e minimizando o impacto nos usuários finais.

Anthropic Claude Models experience

title: Vexos platform manager (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vexos platform manager (remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager
Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil
The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.
We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
About The Render Pros / VEXOS
We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3 D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The Role
The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.
You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What You'll Be Responsible For
• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM
• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials
• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person
• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date
• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track
• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed
• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What We're Looking For
Experience
• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role
• Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus
• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement
Skills
• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily
• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly
• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users
• Highly organized with strong attention to detail
• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure
• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift
Mindset
• You follow through. Every time.
• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated
• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients
• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tools You'll Work With
VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What We Offer
• Competitive salary in USD
• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico
• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder
• A stable, long-term role in a growing company
• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
How to Apply
Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:
1. Who you are and what you've managed
2. Why this role interests you
3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation
Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.
Apply via DM or email:

What We're Looking For
Experience
• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role
• Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus
• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement
Skills
• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily
• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly
• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users
• Highly organized with strong attention to detail
• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure
• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift
Mindset
• You follow through. Every time.
• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated
• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients
• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company

title: Analista data viz sr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista data viz sr. em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável.
O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas.
Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão.
Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.
Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes. Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência. Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade. Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização. Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica). Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário. Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica. Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio. Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados. Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.
Requisitos e qualificações
Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics. Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX). Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker. Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico. Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados. Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold). Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI). Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse. Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações. Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards. Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
Requisitos desejáveis
Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.
Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.
Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).
Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.
Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
Experiência com testes e validação de dados.
Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
100% remoto;
Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;
Seguro de Vida;
Plano de Saúde (Porto Seguro);
Plano Odontológico (Porto Seguro);
PLR de acordo com a política da empresa;
Voucher Smash Card no dia do aniversário;
Parceria com escola de inglês;
Programa de indicação #amigosv8.tech;
Total Pass;
Guapeco (benefício pet);
Alura (plataforma de cursos online);
Certificações de parceiros;
Convênio SESC.

title: Devops | home office
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops | home office em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um profissional que será responsável por implementar, configurar e manter servidores, softwares e sistemas. Implementando rotinas automatizadas, otimizando entregas e trazendo segurança, estabilidade e confiabilidade nos ambientes.
Requisitos:
- Desejável superior em análise de sistemas, ciência da computação ou cursos correlatos;
- Conhecimento em redes de computadores (TCP/IP, VPN, Firewall);
- Sistemas Linux/Unix;
- Docker;
- Kubernetes;
- Ia C (Ansible / Terraform);
- Conhecimento em Cloud (Azure / AWS);
- Pipeline CI/CD;
- Observabilidade (Prometheus / Zabbix).
Competências Comportamentais:
- Comprometimento;
- Detalhista;
- Busca por conhecimento constante;
- Prontidão decisória;
- Ética;
- Boa comunicação;
- Visão crítica.
Dentre as atividades a serem desempenhadas:
- Desenvolver scripts e ferramentas para automatizar a configuração, provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura de TI;
- Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar o processo de construção, teste e implantação de código, permitindo entregas de software rápidas e confiáveis;
- Manter e gerenciar configurações de sistemas e aplicativos de maneira consistente em todos os ambientes, utilizando técnicas como versionamento de configuração e infraestrutura como código;
- Padronizar manifests/Helm charts e políticas de configuração para serviços e ambientes;
- Operar Kubernetes/orquestradores com boas práticas de confiabilidade;
- Facilitar a comunicação e a colaboração entre equipes de desenvolvimento, operações e outras partes interessadas, promovendo uma cultura de colaboração e responsabilidade compartilhada;
- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de infraestrutura e aplicativos, garantindo a rápida resolução de incidentes e minimizando o impacto nos usuários finais.

title: Finance manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Finance Manager
Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)
Job Type: Full-Time
Strong financial operations don't just track performance, they drive it. We're looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.
About Uproot Clean
Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.
We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That's where you come in.
The Role
This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.
You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.
This is not a purely back-office role, you'll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.
This Role Is For You If:
You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
You are detail-oriented and highly organized
You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment This Role Is NOT For You If:
You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment What You'll Do
Accounting & Financial Operations
Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
Prepare financial statements and reports
Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records Month-End Close & Process Improvement
Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
Build scalable processes and documentation Team Oversight
Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work Cost & Inventory Accounting
Manage and apply landed costs across products
Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility Reporting & Analysis
Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking Requirements
Must have:
1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
Strong understanding of accounting principles
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and organization Work Requirements
Schedule: Flexble
Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)
Benefits & Compensation
Fully remote
Paid time off
Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy Ready to Apply?
If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

description:

Acendeo is looking for a hands-on n8n Automation Specialist to build, scale, and evolve our internal automation infrastructure. You'll use n8n to integrate CRMs, e Mail systems, third-party APIs, and AI tools powering our growth engine and operational workflows.

Strong experience with workflow automation tools and demonstrated practical application of n8n

Anthropic Claude Models experience

title: Senior accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Join a team that values you. At Staff Right, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we're growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you'll love building your career with us.
We're looking for a detail-oriented Accountant to support our client with day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes within Net Suite. If you have strong experience managing financial data, ensuring accuracy across accounts, and working within a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.
What You'll Be Doing:
Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes within Net Suite
Prepare and record journal entries, including accruals and adjustments
Perform bank and credit card reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy
Support month-end and year-end close processes
Generate financial reports and assist with basic financial analysis
Review transactions for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
Collaborate with internal teams to clarify financial data and resolve issues
Ensure financial records are organized, accurate, and audit-ready within Net Suite Who We're Looking For:
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Minimum 3+ years of accounting experience
Experience supporting US-based clients or working in a BPO/outsourcing environment is preferred
Hands-on experience with Net Suite and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer Technical Requirements:
Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages Why You'll Love Working Here:
Competitive Compensation
We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 1,200 - 1,600, with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.
Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:
We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.
